title: Bank request
description: One of the member's own booking requests, raised in the Basetool or through any client: no staff note, no staff identities, no counterparty and no purpose. The member's own data: a client may persist it.

id.description: Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

version.description: The request's version, echoed by a correction or a cancel.

decidedAt.description: When the request was confirmed, rejected or cancelled; null while it is pending.

amount.description: The requested amount in whole aUEC.

justification.description: The justification of a withdrawal or transfer; null otherwise.

account.description: The account the request is raised against: the deposit's target, the withdrawal's or transfer's source.

id.description: Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

orgUnitShorthand.description: The owning org unit's shorthand; null for an account without one.

id.description: Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

targetAccount.description: The destination of a transfer; null otherwise.

requiresOwnerApproval.description: Whether the amount exceeded the member's limit, so an approver must sign off before the bank confirms.

requiredApprover.description: Who must approve; null without an approval need.

ownerApprovalGranted.description: Whether the approval was granted in the Basetool.

rejectReason.description: The bank's reason for a rejection; null otherwise.

client.description: The connected application that raised the request; null for one raised in the Basetool.

splitEnabled.description: Whether a deposit distributes splitPercent of the amount across the squadron accounts.

splitPercent.description: The whole percent a split deposit distributes; null without a split.
